hero.title: INVEST IN
hero.intro: Choose the level of support that matches your goals. We’ll confirm the right option together during your free intake.

plans.title: 3 months
plans.text: Weekly personal training for three months—ideal for building momentum, confidence and a consistent routine.

plans.title: 12 months
plans.text: Ongoing coaching at the best session rate, for people ready to make strength training a lasting habit.

plans.title: Monthly
plans.text: A three-month contract including two sessions, an individual schedule and consistent feedback.

plans.title: Single session
plans.text: A focused one-off session for a specific lift or goal, with no ongoing contract.

note: All prices are shown in euros. Final programme structure and session frequency are agreed during intake.
